requirements.title: Korea International Health Certificate (VEHCS, APHIS-endorsed within 30 days)

manual_checklist.title: Microchip before the rabies vaccination
manual_checklist.detail: The microchip must be implanted before the rabies vaccination used for the titre, or QIA may not accept the vaccination history.

manual_checklist.title: Animals under 90 days: titre exemption
manual_checklist.detail: Dogs/cats under 90 days old from a non-rabies-free origin are exempt from the rabies titre but face extra handling. Over-90-day animals from the US need the titre. The engine now models this (min_age_days: 90) when the pet's date of birth is on file — if DOB is missing, the titre check still fires (conservative).

manual_checklist.title: Be ready for on-arrival inspection at QIA
manual_checklist.detail: Documents + animal checked at the port of entry. Carry originals + copies.
